headline: 🔴 Zoomsday zero-click RCE patched, 📋 Microsoft Patch Tuesday hits ~400 CVEs with exploited WinSock zero-day, 🛡️ Cisco ASA/FTD zero-day joins KEV, 🎣 Sandworm trojanizes WireGuard in fake interviews, 🐫 CopyEscape Docker escape, ⚠️ Kimwolf botnet rebuilt with HTTP/2 floods
summary: Zoom patched a zero-click RCE that lets meeting participants execute code on other attendees' devices, Microsoft shipped a near-record Patch Tuesday including an AFD.sys zero-day exploited by Lazarus, perimeter VPN appliances stayed under active attack, and Sandworm pushed trojanized WireGuard installers through fake job interviews.
